moment: You do not want to be measured. You do not want to be the subject of a reading you did not choose to be in. The fragment has already kept one frame of you, and the frame is filed, and the city is about to choose what it will do with you next.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
